title: ARCADE: AN UPGRADE NEVER REPLACES THE GUN IN HAND
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 12 of 20. In the arcade a walk-up player keeps the gun he is shooting. A found gun with a higher tier than his stowed gun takes the stowed slot, and the old stowed gun goes into the backpack on a free gun key (tag STOWED). Otherwise a gun better than the worst gun he carries goes into the backpack on key 3 or 4 (tag KEY 3). Otherwise, or when it is a copy of a gun he already has, it is scrapped for points like a valuable (tag SCRAPPED). Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade a found gun never replaces the gun in your hands: it is stowed, packed on key 3 or 4, or scrapped for points.

edits.anchor: // A kill this window credited to its own player. Returns the points.
